name: AI TeamsMaestro
description:
Your meetings contain decisions, commitments, and context that your AI assistant can't access. TeamsMaestro changes that by connecting your entire meeting history to Claude.

The fastest growing AI note taker for Microsoft users, TeamsMaestro joins your calls on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom, automatically capturing everything so nothing gets lost.

Works great for:

- Proposals and docs grounded in what was actually discussed in meetings
- Client call preparation by surfacing everything from past sessions, then going deeper with Claude
- Performance reviews backed by real context and commitments from past conversations
- Missed meeting catch-ups with the ability to ask Claude follow-up questions
- Engineering workflows enriched with project background, requirements, and technical decisions from planning meetings
- Strategic analysis that combines meeting insights with documents and data

Instead of copy-pasting transcripts into Claude and hoping it finds the right detail, TeamsMaestro gives your AI direct access to your meeting history. It pulls exactly what it needs, cites the right conversation, and keeps you focused on the work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AI TeamsMaestro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AI TeamsMaestro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.maestrolabs.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AI TeamsMaestro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI TeamsMaestro provides these MCP tools: get_meeting_action_items, get_meeting_summary, get_meeting_transcript, get_product_faq, list_recent_meetings, list_upcoming_meetings, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AI TeamsMaestro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AI TeamsMaestro in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does AI TeamsMaestro MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI TeamsMaestro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AI TeamsMaestro is developed by MaestroLabs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
